scope: 60 REDS sequences, 100 verified sharp frames each, not completed codec bank or training

spec.frame_rate_source: official REDS page identifies standard release as 24fps
spec.entry_validation: pinned-index CRC32, exact size/name, local SHA256

masters.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 2023-05-11-git-ceb050427c-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers
masters.split_rule: First two seeded selected sequences are development validation; others train.
masters.limitation: Source family is identified only at sequence level; no independent camera/session-family verification.

storage: D: HDD for sequential corpus preparation; I: SSD for mapped training pairs; no source media in repository
